```{r}
data<-  read_excel("20260923_1333_3610_SPO_cfu_ph.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")

```




```{r}
cfu <- function(colony, dilution, volume){
  DF <- 10^(-dilution)
  (colony * DF) / volume
}

data <- data %>%
  mutate(CFU = cfu(Count, Dilution, 0.1))


ggplot(data, aes(Time, color = Type)) +
  stat_summary(aes(y = log10(CFU)), fun = mean, geom = "line") + #CFU
  stat_summary(aes(y = log10(CFU)), fun.data = mean_sdl,
               fun.args = list(mult = 1), geom = "pointrange") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 48)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expression(log[10] * " CFU/mL"),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . - 2, name = "pH")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(WT = "black", SPO = "grey"))



```

```{r}
mean_data <- data %>%
  group_by(Time, Type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_CFU = mean(CFU, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ph  = mean(ph, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_data

mean_data<- rename(mean_data, 
             CFU = mean_CFU, 
             ph = mean_ph)

data$Time<-as.factor(data$Time)
data$Type <- as.factor(data$Type)

data.aov <-aov(CFU~Time*Type, data)
summary(data.aov)

post<-TukeyHSD(data.aov)
```
